oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: routing.p99 spike detected in eu-west-2 at 12:07 UTC — auto-paging oncall
Aisha (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge. seeing p95 ~ 180ms -> p99 ~ 980ms for router decisions, streaming stalls on some shards :grimacing:
Mateo (eng-sre): Confirming. heatmap shows concentrated tail in shard-range 0x3a..0x4f, consistent with sudden route oscillation after config push 12:05 UTC
Priya (runtime): Logs show repeated route-rewrite decisions: 
```
router decision loop: src=ingress-2 dest=pool-A -> pool-B -> pool-A count=6
metric: misassign_rate=12.4/s, tail_latency=860ms
```
Dan (ingress): We deployed a balancer policy change at 12:04 that adjusted region weights and enabled eager-fallback. Rolling back now to prior policy (ID: policy-2026-03-12-03)
Sunita (product): Any immediate customer-facing impact? CS reported a Chat streaming timeout from one customer in EUW2 12:06-12:09 UTC
Aisha (oncall): Quick customer assessment: ~0.8% of requests in eu-west-2 experienced >5s stall, error rate bumped from 0.2% -> 1.9% for a 3m window. notifying CS.
ops-bot: rollback triggered by Dan at 12:13 UTC — policy-2026-03-12-03 restored.
Mateo (eng-sre): After rollback p95 down to 120ms, p99 drifting to 350ms. Still above target but much improved.
Priya (runtime): Streaming layer still shows leftover KV cache fragmentation on hot shards causing stalls for active streams. Evicting prefix caches on impacted shard-range now: `./tools/evict_kv --shard 0x3a-0x4f --reason routing-loop`
Aisha (oncall): Executed eviction. Observed immediate drop in stall retries. p99 now ~210ms at 12:22 UTC
Dan (ingress): Root cause hypothesis: eager-fallback + regional weight shift created a small set of hot partitions. The router's affinity heuristic started flipping weights rapidly -> short-lived misassigns -> inflight streaming sessions got remapped mid-stream which caused stalls.
Mateo (eng-sre): Corroborating traces: See span 0x7f2 showing 4 sequential redirects inside 250ms for same request. That correlates with replayed model loads and KV cache churn.
Sunita (product): Which customers hit worst? any paid tier SLAs breached?
Aisha (oncall): CS list: two enterprise customers reported degraded streaming; one hit soft-SLA (latency breach) but no 5xx. We'll open an incident ticket for those accounts.
Priya (runtime): Longer-term mitigation: add sticky routing for active streams (keep-alive affinity) and guardrails in the eager-fallback logic to avoid flipping within 30s window. Raising PR for gating rule.
Dan (ingress): Also proposing rate-limit change: throttle policy rollouts that change effective weight by >10% per region without canary.
Mateo (eng-sre): For immediate mitigation: 1) policy rollback done; 2) prefix eviction executed; 3) temp throttle on eager-fallback (disabled) via runtime flag `router.eager_fallback.enabled=false` — applied at 12:25 UTC. Monitoring.
ops-bot: flag updated: router.eager_fallback.enabled=false by Mateo at 12:25 UTC
Aisha (oncall): Monitoring window 12:25-12:40: p99 trending down to 160ms, streaming retries back to baseline. marking paging -> standby.
Sunita (product): Thanks team. Please capture customer incident notes and mitigation summary for postmortem. Prioritize product asks: sticky stream routing + rollout throttles.
Mateo (eng-sre): Capturing diagnostics: attached grep output (short): 
```
# hotspots
shard 0x3a: misassigns=234, avg_retry=3
shard 0x3b: misassigns=192, streaming_retries=78
```
Aisha (oncall): Action items: Mateo -> collect full traces + timeline; Priya -> PR for fallback guardrail (P0); Dan -> rollout throttle proposal; Sunita -> customer comms draft. I'll reopen if any regression.
Priya (runtime): Noted. PR in progress: will include unit+integration tests for sticky affinity and a canary gating rule.
Dan (ingress): I'll add a temporary telemetry alert that triggers when route flips/sec > 2 for a shard-range.
ops-bot: Incident auto-summary generated at 12:40 UTC: short-lived routing oscillation after policy rollout caused hot-shard misassigns and streaming stalls in eu-west-2. Immediate rollback + cache eviction + disable eager-fallback mitigated.
Aisha (oncall): Closing page, moving to postmortem phase. I'll coordinate with CS for account follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
